title: Add imageWidth, imageHeight, and imageAspectRatio to HTMLImageElement
body: Stacked on #13192. Fixes #12565. Adds `imageWidth`, `imageHeight`, and `imageAspectRatio` readonly attributes to `HTMLImageElement` to expose an image's unscaled natural dimensions and natural aspect ratio directly (without `current pixel density` division or the 300×150 default object size fallback applied by `naturalWidth` and `naturalHeight`): - `imageWidth` returns `this`'s [natural width](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-width) if `this` is *available* and has a natural width; otherwise `0`. - `imageHeight` returns `this`'s [natural height](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-height) if `this` is *available* and has a natural height; otherwise `0`. - `imageAspectRatio` returns `this`'s [natural aspect ratio](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-aspect-ratio) as a `double` if `this` is *available* and has a natural aspect ratio; otherwise `0.0`. - [x] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * … * … - [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/64743 - [ ] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Chromium: … * Gecko: … * WebKit: … - [ ] [MDN issue](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) is filed: … - [x] The top of this comment includes a [clear commit message](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/COMMITTING.md) to use.
